name: Nornäs - Vassbotten
routeType: point-to-point official Bohusleden stage; remote hard stage on dirt road, forest path, old paths, ridges and late-stage border/waterfall terrain

officialSources.title: West Sweden Trails / Bohusleden: Stage 23 Nornäs - Vassbotten
keyFacts: Primary official name is 23. Nornäs - Vassbotten.
West Sweden Trails facts are 13 km, 5-6 h and hard/red.
West Sweden Trails attributes the stage to Tanums kommun in Västra Götaland.
Surface is dirt road and forest path.
Route runs through forested, rolling terrain near Norra Kornsjön and close to the Norwegian border.

Official prose mentions old border cairns, older footpaths, pine ridges, clear-cut or overgrown areas, a croft ruin at Djupvik with information sign, Abborrtjärnen/Bockögat, and Älgafallet about 1 km before Vassbotten.
Neither Nornäs nor Vassbotten is described as easy to reach by public transport.
Nornäs has shelter, dry toilet, rubbish bin and swimming in official WST context.
Vassbotten endpoint area has Bullarebygdens Familjecamping and Nellies Place just south of Vassbotten.
caveats: Swedish WST text includes the Nornäs private-road / Norane parking warning that is easy to miss in English text.
No official drinking-water point was confirmed on the stage.

GPX Last-Modified header is 2021-12-01 and GPX metadata time is 2021-10-25.
caveats: De-duplicate consecutive triplicated coordinates before normalization.
Treat old GPX timestamps as a stale-risk flag, but geometry is corroborated by Naturkartan and OSM.
